canonical_name: Supply Chain Risk Management Not Implemented
description: Supply chain risk management for critical components is not implemented. This signal indicates that compromised or counterfeit components may enter the environment.
applicability: Applicable to Level 3 environments with supply chain concerns. Includes vendor risk assessment, component verification, and supply chain security programs.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through supply chain program review, vendor assessment verification, and component authenticity testing.
